The Player side receives items other players send you, e.g. a thank-you gift after you revive someone — if you are not online at that moment, it comes by mail instead, so nothing is lost.
Writing new mail to other players — the server supports it, but the game has no button/screen to write a new mail Attaching T-Stones to mail for players — only items can be sent

d: Island types (Ancora, Safe House, Tamed Island, Unstable Islands, Civilized Islands, Lawless Islands) · Unstable Island lifespan · camps on Unstable Islands · Tamed Islands expanded to 1024 · the Supporter Tamed Island and private islands · sailing, balloons, returning to a Stable Island · island levels, Unstable Index and danger

sec.x: The world of Durango is an archipelago. Every island has its own level and climate. Some islands are safe and permanent (you can settle there), others are Unstable Islands — more dangerous, with better loot, and only around for a limited time. Everyone on the server shares the same world: you meet, help and compete with other players on the same islands. An Unstable Island on the sailing map

Start on Ancora → build a raft → arrive at The Company's Safe House Take the Hot Air Balloon to claim your own Tamed Island, then declare a Domain · players with the Supporter role get the Supporter Tamed Island (a big 10-biome island) or can choose a private Tamed Island and decide who may enter it Sail from a Harbor to Unstable Islands in 8 climates, level 15–60, to gather and hunt — an Unstable Island lasts 12 hours to 3 days, then disappears and a new one takes its place · most have a camp for missions and Tech Support, and you can return to it for free with the "Return to Camp" button on the map Pick your own difficulty with each island's Unstable Index (1–10) At level 56+, sail to the Lawless Islands where players can fight each other — Lawless Islands (PvP) Go home for free at any time with Sail to the last Stable Island or the warp buttons on Warps & Rifts

Type   Island level   Domain   Unstable Index   Island fatigue   Lifespan Ancora (starting island)   1   No   1 (stable)   None   Permanent The Company's Safe House   5   No   1 (stable)   None   Permanent Tamed Island   10   Yes (free expansion)   1 (stable)   None   Permanent Supporter Tamed Island   10   Yes (1 plot)   1 (stable)   None   Permanent Unstable Island   15–60   No   1–10   Yes   12 hours – 3 days Training island (tropical)   18   No   1 (stable)   Half   Permanent Civilized Island (abandoned city)   40   Yes   1 (stable)   Half   Permanent Event islands   20–60   No   1   Yes   12 hours – 3 days Lawless Island (PvP)   60 (enter from Lv56)   No   1   Yes   Permanent

Every new character starts on Ancora — the tutorial island, rebuilt from the original game's real map. Follow the tutorial, finish the raft (4 logs · 6 reed stems) and it carries you to the Safe House · a new character starts a little hurt — see New characters start injured The scenery now matches the original game (2019 footage): the bonfire plaza has an old paved road, a pile of car tires, and Charlie waiting behind the fire · the beach has survivors sitting around a small fire with an animal carcass, scaffolding and tires · the other survivors moved next to the raft · a 2nd date palm, a nest-fern patch, reeds and shells on the beach were added Resources were rebuilt to match the original: everything is on ground you can walk to — nothing on cliffs or unreachable plateaus · the tutorial spots have what the tutorial asks for (dates at the train cars · reeds at the stream · stones by the lake · branches and stones at the bonfire · log trees and reeds around the small lake by the raft) — details in Getting Started Resource amounts and regrow speed are the same as on other islands (no special multiplier anymore) Resting at the bonfire on Ancora empties your fatigue in 5 seconds, however long your gauge is (Resting) Animals: the Brachiosaurus stay in the lake only · 3 Compsognathus herds near the spawn valley and along the stream — harmless, they run when hit, a good first hunt (Compsognathus on Ancora and the Safe House) · the 2 at the train cars are scenery models You can sail

The hub for new players — K and the Company's staff, a workbench, a campfire, a notice board, a Harbor, a balloon station and Warp Holes you can use right away without finding them. If you haven't set a Waypoint anywhere, the Safe House is your "home". Harmless Compsognathus herds roam around the arrival point.

A level 10 grassland island for settling down — declare a Domain, build a house, farm, raise animals. Expanding a Domain on a Tamed Island is free, and there is no climate fatigue from the island itself. Tamed Islands have no wild animals at all — no dinosaurs or bosses spawn there, so it's a safe island for building and farming · your own pets and caged animals are unaffected · to hunt or tame, go to another island. Tamed Islands are a shared world — everyone who picks the same island layout lives on the same island. You see each other and can visit each other's homes, like a village where everyone stakes out their own plot. Spots already declared show as owned, so look for the next free one. (Supporters can use a private Tamed Island instead — see below.) Your first trip to your Tamed Island is by Hot Air Balloon from the Safe House (see Hot Air Balloon below). You can pick from 5 island layouts (next section).

All 5 Tamed Island layouts are now 1024 × 1024 tiles (16 times the old 256 × 256) — the original island sits in the middle of the map Houses, buildings, Domains, boxes/storage, cages, pets and things in the water are all exactly where they were — nothing to move The sea around the old island became grassland joined to the new part, with rivers/lakes and the same gatherable items as the old island · the harbor stays where it was (with a small bay around it) · the new part has few fish (the total fish per island is the same as before the expansion) 5 Warp Holes (four directions + the middle of the island) work the moment you arrive, no exploring needed (Warps & Rifts) · one balloon station next to the harbor for free flights A player without a Domain on a Tamed Island arrives at the free spot nearest the harbor and can declare a Domain at once (later arrivals get the next spot further out) The Supporter's private Tamed Island expands the same way

The first time you press Leave at the balloon station, the Declare Tamed Island screen lets you pick from 5 grassland island layouts, each with a different map. Tamed Island layout 1 Tamed Island layout 2 Tamed Island layout 3 Tamed Island layout 4 Tamed Island layout 5 You choose once — the layout can't be changed afterwards Players who already have a Tamed Island keep it and are not moved Each layout is its own shared world — players who pick the same layout live together Same rules for all: level 10 · Index 1 · no wild animals · free Domain expansion

Players with the Supporter role get the Supporter Tamed Island — one big island of 1024 × 1024 tiles with 10 biomes: a round volcano in the middle, ringed by grassland · snow field · tundra · temperate forest · savanna · desert · tropical forest · indigo tropical forest · swamp. All Supporters share this one island (non-Supporters cannot declare a Domain on it). Level 10 across the island · Index 1 · no island fatigue · only small herbivores of each biome to capture/tame, no predators · no fish or shrimp swarms in the sea (player-built fish traps still work) 4 harbors, one in each corner, each with a field base: Communication Center (missions / organization support / Tech Support) · supply storehouse · mission board · campfire · a balloon station for free flights 14 Warp Holes (one in the middle of each biome + one beside each harbor) · normal day/night A Supporter who has never typed /tamed goes here the next time they go to the Tamed Island · the houses/Domains you already have on the shared or private Tamed Island stay exactly where they are, nothing is deleted or moved · on this island you can declare 1 new Domain Other players can visit your Domain here under the permissions you set (Visiting private Tamed Islands)

Players with the Supporter role can choose a private Tamed Island — the same layout you picked, but for that character only. Other players can't see it or enter it (except people you allow — next section). It's still the same server as everyone else: chat, friends, clans and the market work as usual. One per character · same island rules as the shared Tamed Island (level 10 · no wild animals · free Domain expansion) Switch by typing in chat: /tamed supporter = the Supporter Tamed Island (the default for anyone who has not chosen yet) · /tamed private = your private island · /tamed shared = the shared Tamed Island · typing it while on the Tamed Island moves you right away · anywhere else, it applies next time you go to your Tamed Island Everything you built on the shared Tamed Island stays where it is — the private island starts empty (you can move your old land over once — see "Moving your land to your private island") The role is checked every time you log in — if it ends, you go to the shared Tamed Island next time and your private island is kept; get the role back and you return Everyone else keeps using the shared Tamed Island as before

The island owner (a Supporter) decides who may enter in the Island Entry Permissions window (the Domain screen on the private island) — tick Clan Member · Friend · Outsider, several at once if you like ("Outsider" = everyone) Default = all closed, only the owner can enter Closing a group sends that group's visitors back to their own Tamed Island at once Up to 20 visitors at a time (the owner not counted) · allowed players can visit even while the owner is offline · an online owner gets a message when someone arrives Removing a visitor: tap them on your island → the kick-from-island button → they're sent back to their own Tamed Island · Block them = sent back at once and can't enter your island again To visit — use the sailing menu at a Harbor (Random Sailing) · you arrive at the island's arrival point On someone else's island: walk, chat and gather natural resources · inside the owner's land the owner's permissions apply (outsiders normally can't build or open boxes/cages) · you can't declare land or build outside the owner's land Only Supporters' private Tamed Islands can be visited this way (the shared Tamed Island is open to everyone anyway)

sec.h: Moving your land to your private island
sec.x: A Supporter can move their land from the shared Tamed Island to their private island once per character (no deadline) — houses, buildings, boxes with everything inside, cages and the animals in them are placed at the exact same spot on the private island. Type /tamed move in chat → you get a summary of what will move Type /tamed move confirm within 60 seconds to confirm (/tamed move cancel = cancel) Works while your private island has no land yet · if something on the private island is in the way, you're told to remove it first · a failed move, or no land on the shared island, costs nothing — your move stays available and everything stays put Things your friends built on your land move with it · other players' animals in your cages go back to their owners · anything outside your land stays where it is Confirming while standing on the shared Tamed Island takes you to your private island right away · afterwards the Tamed Island button takes you to the private island

sec.h: K and D383 on the Tamed Island
sec.x: While you play the epic story, K and Agent D383 appear on your own Tamed Island according to the quest step. They appear at a fixed spot on the new grassland part of the Tamed Island that was expanded to 1024, far from the dock (about 540 tiles) — follow the game's navigation arrow They only appear on your own Tamed Island — not on the shared Supporter Tamed Island, and not on another player's island when you visit Finishing chapter 8 plays the ending movie, and then the game takes you back to your Tamed Island

Islands you reach by sailing — high-level resources and aggressive animals. Most islands of level 20 and above have Rifts and craters. The higher the level or Index, the more dangerous. You cannot declare Domains here · every one of them has a lifespan (next section). 37 new islands (maps generated from scratch) add 10 areas of 4 islands each, Index 1 · 4 · 7 · 10 (Temperate Forest 20 has a single island): Temperate Forest 20 · Tundra 40 · Deep Swamp 45 · Desert 50 · Deep Swamp 55 · Indigo Tropical Forest 55 · Snowfield 60 · Desert 60 · Tropical Forest 60 · Tundra 60 — each has about 40% land, rivers, lakes, cliffs, 5 Warp Holes, 6 craters, 2 Rifts and a camp · names in game are in Thai, e.g. "ทุนดรา 40-1" Every Unstable Island has resident animals, crater caches and pack leaders that follow the original game's island table, so each sea has its own species · the Indigo Tropical Forest 55 islands have their own set of 23 plants/stones Lakes and rivers — the lakes on the 41 older islands (the 02–04 sets, Civilized, Lawless and event islands) used to show only the lake bed; now they have a water surface and banks, and you wade in by the real depth · on every island (except Ancora, which looks as before) the sea edge, lakes, rivers and flow direction now match the real water area used for drawing water/fishing/swimming (it used to be drawn 1 tile off) Climate   Level   Islands   Name shown in game   Unstable Index Savanna   15   1   (no name yet)   1–10 · +1 each time the island

Unstable Islands and event islands last 12 hours to 3 days depending on the island, and they don't all expire at the same time. The time left is shown as Island Life Span on the map. When   What happens 1 hour and 10 minutes left   Message "Island will disappear after …" Expired   "The island will disappear soon. Returning to your Waypoint in …" — a 60-second countdown, then you're taken to your Waypoint (home island · none = the Safe House) · if you're dead, you're revived for free first About 1.5 minutes after expiry   A fresh island takes its place — you can't sail to it until then Anything left on the island disappears with it: buildings, houses, boxes and their contents, camps you set up yourself, land claims, dropped items — except pets (they stay with their owner) and vehicles (moved to the Safe House) The new island: resources back in full · all animals respawn · crater caches re-rolled · single islands go up one Index · the island's shape stays the same A newly spawned island shows a NEW badge on the sailing screen for its first hour Maps you bought/opened, fog, explored markers and the full-exploration reward start over on the new island (Map and exploration) · the island's message board is cleared If you logged out there and the island expires, you'll be at your Waypoint next time you log in, with "The island disappeared and you were moved to your Waypoint." No lifespan: Ancora · Safe House · Tamed Islands (including the Supporter Tamed Island) · training island ·

Most Unstable Islands have a camp near the harbor/arrival point (all islands of level 15–60 including every one of the new sets · the "Desert / Temperate / Tropical Forest / Savanna / Snowfield / Tundra 1" islands and the single islands of level 15 · 20 · 25 · 30 · the 2–4 islands and event islands already had a field base) — except Deep Swamp 1 and Volcano 1, which have none, and the training island, Tamed Islands and Ancora. Camp piece   What it does Communication Center   Take/hand in faction missions (Organizations) · the "Tech Support" menu (equipment modification estimates) Camp storehouse   Hand in the items of delivery missions Board   Read/write the island's board Campfire   Sit to rest + craft (Survival) Courier warp hole   Warp across the island + send items home (Transport) Return to camp for free with the button on the map (Map and exploration) · if you die on an island with a camp and pick a revive other than a warp hole, you respawn at the camp (Death & Revival) If the usual spot has a player's house or land on it, the camp moves to the nearest free spot instead · you cannot build over a camp · trees/stones under a camp are not shown · the camp keeps its position even when the island expires and is reborn
A level 18 tropical island with the survival tutorial (find a crater, find the harbor). You can sail there from any Harbor. Its Index is always 1, it has no predators, and island fatigue is halved.
Four abandoned cities at level 40 (grassland · temperate · tropical · tundra) — stable islands where you can declare a Domain. Island fatigue is halved.

Islands from the original game's past events (grassland festival · Summer Club · Season 1/2 islands) are open as normal islands with Index 1 and a lifespan like Unstable Islands. If you log out while on an event island, you'll wake up at home next time (see "Logging out on a temporary island" below).

Five level 60 islands (volcano · swamp · snowfield · temperate · tropical) where players can fight each other — open from level 56 · Index 1 · no lifespan · no Domains · details on Lawless Islands (PvP)

Walk to a Harbor and tap it → choose Sail The sea map opens — pick a climate/level, then an island by the Index you want Confirm "Do you want to move to the … island?" → you land at that island's arrival point Sailing is free — no T-Stones — and islands are not level-locked. You can go to a level 60 island at level 1, but you'll tire very fast · except the Lawless Islands, which need level 56+ Islands with Index 3 or higher need enough climate resistance (table below), or you can't set sail · pioneer grade no longer locks islands — every grade can pick any Index (pioneer grade still sets your land size) An island that is respawning (about 1.5 minutes after it expires) can't be sailed to Your pets and everything in your bag come with you Reach a friend's land on a Stable Island without sailing: tap the player → the go-to-land button (Warps & Rifts)

The Harbor's sailing menu has 2 buttons for visiting other players' private Tamed Islands (Visiting private Tamed Islands) To Tamed Island → search a player by name → pick who to visit Random Sailing → go to someone's island that is open to Outsiders and not full · none open = you get a message Sailing there is free · not allowed / full = you can't go, and a message says why

sec.h: Recommended islands and Record Tamed Island
sec.x: Check Recommended Islands — while standing on an island where you can declare a Domain, open the Domain screen → "Move your Domain" → "Check Recommended Islands" to see the Civilized Islands that are least crowded (relative to their capacity) first, not counting the island you are on · tap one to travel there at once Record Tamed Island — Settings menu, Service section, button "Record Tamed Island" saves your own Tamed Island (Domain, buildings inside the Domain, bag) to your device — only for your own island and only once you have a Domain on it · data up to 2 MiB · once per 10 minutes

At the Harbor of an Unstable Island you get Sail to the last Stable Island and "Return to the Tamed Island harbor you started from?" — both take you straight to your home island, for free. Home island = the island where you used Designate as Waypoint (your own bed/tent) · never set = the Safe House Leaving any island clears that island's automatic checkpoint (a bed/tent Waypoint is kept)

Hot Air Balloon The balloon station at the Safe House offers two things: Leave — go to your Tamed Island (the first time, the Declare Tamed Island screen opens first so you can pick 1 of 5 layouts) Board Hot Air Balloon — fly freely over the island, even across water. Free to board · flights last up to 15 minutes, then you land automatically · you can't land on water/cliffs — you'll be sent back to the station Free-flight-only balloon stations also stand on every Tamed Island (next to the harbor) and on the Supporter Tamed Island (all 4 harbor corners) — details on Transport and Vehicles

As in the original game, you can't leave the island or use a warp you start yourself while in combat mode — sailing · sailing back/returning to a stable island · warping to the harbor · Return to Camp · returning to your rest point/estate · warp holes · visiting a friend's estate or Tamed Island · random sailing Leave combat first, then wait about 8 seconds after your last combat event (hitting, being hit, dodging, or your pet fighting) before you set off — try too early and a message tells you how many seconds are left Death, revival, the tutorial and moves the server makes for you (e.g. an island expiring) are not affected Leaving the Brawl Island still uses the match's own button

The higher the Index, the tougher the animals and the faster you tire — but mission exp and the latent properties on what you gather get better too. Index   Required resistance   Recommended resistance   Animal HP/attack 1   —   1   ×1.00 2   —   4   ×1.25 3   3   8   ×1.50 4   7   14   ×1.75 5   12   19   ×2.00 6   17   27   ×2.25 7   25   39   ×2.50 8   35   51   ×2.75 9   43   51   ×3.00 10   51   51   ×3.25 The resistance must match the island's climate (Temperate/Grassland islands accept your highest resistance of any type) — see Weather · the highest resistance level is 51 Single islands at level 15/20/25/30 move up one Index each time the island expires and respawns (1 → 10, then back to 1) — it never changes during an island's lifespan Index 2+ adds fatigue: Index 2 = +1.0/min · 8 = +4.0/min · 10 = +5.0/min

On an island above your level, your fatigue rises quickly — that's what keeps beginners away from level 60 islands (there is no level lock, except on the Lawless Islands). Character level   Island level   Fatigue/min (weather not included) 1   18   4.55 20   35   6.30 35   35   4.50 40   60   9.60 60   60   6.00 60   35   3.00 Heat, cold and storms add more — see Weather and Survival.

Every wild animal (bosses and guards included) spawns at island level ±5 on every island — a level 60 island gets animals of roughly level 55–65 (this server no longer has a special high-level band for level 55–60 islands) — see Wild animals Tamed Islands have no wild animals · the Supporter Tamed Island has only small herbivores A 12-tile radius around every Harbor and arrival point is a safe zone: animals don't spawn or walk in there, and predators chasing you give up when you run into it · but if you hit an animal first, it can hit back from the edge while you are within its reach (When an animal is hit) · the zone only keeps out animals — on a Lawless Island players can still hit you inside it

sec.h: Logging out on a temporary island
sec.x: If you log out or disconnect while on a temporary island — an Unstable Island with Index 2+, an event island, or the training island — the next time you log in you'll be on your home island (or the Safe House) with the message "The island disappeared and you were moved to your Waypoint." Everything you carry and your pets come with you. Stable islands (Safe House · Ancora · Tamed Island · Civilized Islands · Lawless Islands · Unstable Islands with Index 1) → you come back where you were Arriving on a temporary island by boat doesn't move you — it only happens on the next login after you log out An island that expires while you're offline → you're always moved to your Waypoint, even at Index 1 (Island lifespan)

On every Unstable Island, at every Index (Index 1 too), the craters are resource caches — 10 natural resources of one kind around the crater (5-tile radius), guarded by 3 animals that are ×1.5 tougher than normal (on top of the island's Index). The cache types match the original game's island, e.g. Iron Mine, Rubber Tree Cache, Fir Forest, Marble Mine, Animal Graveyard, Icy Floor, Gray Mud Pit, Warp Remnants (names are shown in Thai in game) · cache types and guards are re-rolled each time the island respawns. On some islands only part of the craters are caches, following the original island's share (e.g. Desert 35: 4 of 4 craters · Tropical Forest 40: 2 of 2 · Snowfield 50: 1 of 2) — the others are dormant craters that open with Resource Induction Stones (Warps & Rifts) · every island with craters has at least 1 cache Islands with no craters on their map (the single islands of level 15 · 25 · 30 · Little Snowfield · Temperate Forest 1–4 level 35 · Tundra 1–4 level 55) have no caches

What   Value Sailing / returning to a Stable Island   Free Raft to leave Ancora   4 logs · 6 reed stems Longest balloon flight   15 minutes Safe zone around Harbors/arrival points   12 tiles Animal level   Island level ±5 (a level 60 island = about 55–65) Tamed Island size   1024 × 1024 tiles (the Supporter Tamed Island too) Unstable Index   1–10 (4-island areas = 1 · 4 · 7 · 10) Resistance needed for Index 9 / 10   Level 43 / 51 (maximum 51) Single-island Index   +1 each time the island respawns Animals at Index 10   ×3.25 Unstable/event island lifespan   12 hours – 3 days Warnings before an island disappears   1 hour · 10 minutes · 60-second countdown Level to enter Lawless Islands   56 Visitors on a private Tamed Island at once   20

[!tip] Set a Waypoint (bed/tent) on the island you want as home before heading out — returning to a Stable Island and waking up after logging out on a temporary island both bring you back there. [!tip] Beginners should start with island 1 of each climate (Index 1) — no resistance needed and animals aren't boosted. [!warn] Don't build a home or store things on Unstable or event islands — when the island expires, everything goes with it · before logging out on an Unstable Island with Index 2+, pick up anything you placed there — next time you log in you won't be on that island anymore.
Single islands at level 15 / 25 / 30 have no name in the sailing confirm box yet (they show an island code)

d: Warp Holes on an island · quick-warp buttons (Harbor, Waypoint, Domain) · Rifts and the Warp Accelerator (1,000 T-Stone entry, rewards, weekly cap) · Dormant Craters

sec.x: The Warp that shattered Durango into islands left traces you can use — Warp Holes carry you across an island in an instant, quick-warp buttons take you back to the harbor or home, and Unstable Islands have Rifts where you can start a Warp Accelerator: fight off waves of animals pulled in by the Warp for T-Stones, exp and rare materials. A Rift in the ground

Find Warp Holes on an island and warp between the ones you've found — free Use quick warps To Harbor · To Waypoint · Return to Domain — free Start a Warp Accelerator at a Rift, invite friends, clear each tier's animals in time and collect rewards Open a Dormant Crater so natural resources warp in around it (needs Resource Induction Stones — sold in the shop)

Warp Hole Warp Holes exist on almost every Unstable Island of level 20 and up (the single islands of level 15 · 20 snow · 25 · 30 have none), Civilized Islands (except the grassland ruins), event islands (except the grassland festival), Lawless Islands, the Safe House, Tamed Islands and the Supporter Tamed Island — the training island and Ancora have none. How many: Deep Swamp 1–4 (level 60) · Volcano 1–4 and the swamp/volcano Lawless Islands have 2 · the other Unstable Islands (including Deep Swamp 45/55 and the new island sets) and most Civilized Islands have 5 · Tamed Islands have 5 (four directions + the middle of the island) · the Supporter Tamed Island has 14 Explore until you find a Warp Hole — the first time you find one you get a discovery reward (on Tamed Islands you know all 5 the moment you arrive, with no discovery reward) You need to find at least 2 Warp Holes on the same island before you can warp ("You need to find at least two Warp Holes to use them.") Tap a Warp Hole → Warp → pick the destination hole on the map → wait 2 seconds Warping between holes is free · only holes on the island you're on At the Safe House, every Warp Hole counts as found from the start When you die you can revive at a Warp Hole you've found — see Death Discovery reward (first time per spot)   T-Stones Find a Warp Hole   400 Find a crater   400 Find a Rift   400 Discover every point of interest on an island (once per island)   4,000

Button   Takes you to   Cost To Harbor   The nearest Harbor on this island   Free · 2 seconds To Waypoint   The bed/tent you used Designate as Waypoint on · none = your latest checkpoint · none either = the island's arrival point   Free · 2 seconds Return to Domain   The middle of your Domain (Land), even on another island   Free To Tamed Island Domain   Your Tamed Island   Free Return to Camp (on the map)   The camp of the island you are on — beside the camp's warp hole (Map)   Free · 2 seconds Go to a player's land (player info pop-up)   That player's land on a Stable Island (Civilized Island) — works even if the owner is offline   Free Designate as Waypoint only works on your own finished bed/tent, while standing next to it · the island with your Waypoint is the "home island" that returning to a Stable Island takes you to — see Islands & Travel Automatic checkpoints are cleared when you leave an island; a bed/tent Waypoint stays You can't warp while dead

Items, attributes or statuses that reduce warp cost now apply to warp costs (up to 90% off) — but every warp on this page is already free, so you won't see a difference yet · the 1,000 T-Stone Warp Accelerator entry fee is not reduced

Warp Accelerator A Rift is a crack in the ground leaking Warp energy. There are 2 per island (3 on Volcano islands) on Unstable Islands of level 20 and up that have Warp Holes (including the new island sets), the temperate/tropical/tundra Civilized Islands, most event islands and the Lawless Islands — Deep Swamp islands have no Rifts in their map, so the server places 2 on each · none on the single islands of level 15 · 25 · 30 and Snowfield Lite, on Tamed Islands or the Safe House.

Tap an idle Rift → start the Warp Accelerator, paying the 1,000 T-Stone entry fee — everyone on the island gets an announcement Friends have 10 seconds to tap the Rift and join (also 1,000 T-Stones · within 10 tiles of the Rift · up to 10 players) Each tier, guard animals (the island's predators) appear around the Rift in 2 waves — clear them all within 60 seconds After a tier you get a 15-second break, then the next tier starts, up to 10 tiers · from tier 3, Allosaurus join the waves Run out of time = the run ends · tap the Rift to collect rewards within 2 minutes (once per player) · failing tier 1 = no reward The Rift then rests for 3 minutes before a new run can start Leaving the island or disconnecting mid-run removes you from the run — no reward for that run If starting/joining fails, your T-Stones are refunded Tier   Animals per tier (1 player)   Animals per tier (4 players) 1   3   5 3   5   9 5   7   12 10   12   20 Animals = (2 + tier) × (1 + 0.25 × (players − 1)), at most 20 per tier

Unstable Islands with craters have Dormant Craters. Insert Resource Induction Stones, wait 4 seconds, and the crater opens for 10 minutes — 10 cache-type natural resources for that island warp in around it (5-tile radius) and vanish when it closes · some of an island's craters are already permanent caches and need no stones (Permanent crater caches) Resource Induction Stones are sold in the shop, Recommended tab — a pack of 10 stones for 10 Warp Gems (Shop) The natural red-glowing craters on the ground now show only the name "Crater" when tapped — no gather button, no stones, and they no longer vanish Island level   Resource Induction Stones needed 20   4 35   7 40   8 45   9 50   10 55   11 60   12

[!tip] When you land on a new island, find at least 2 Warp Holes first — you get discovery T-Stones and a fast escape if an aggressive animal shows up. [!tip] The Warp Accelerator pays best on high-level islands with a team that can clear many tiers — at level 20 you need all 10 tiers just to break even, at level 35 you need 6 tiers to earn back the entry fee in T-Stones, while at level 60, 3 tiers already puts you ahead (before counting exp and materials). [!warn] Don't leave the island or close the game mid-run — you'll drop out of the run and get no reward, even though you paid the entry fee.
The original game gave out Resource Induction Stones from missions and attendance — this server does not hand them out that way yet; for now the only source is buying them in the shop.
The original game's button to warp back to your previous island isn't available yet — use a Harbor instead.
Clan Courier Warp Holes (claiming, taxes, defense) aren't available yet — see Clan.
Warp Rush The original game's Warp Rush event mode isn't available yet — its island (Deep Swamp Season 2) is open as a normal island.

Open the map and press Return to Camp to warp back to the camp of the island you are on — free, a 2-second warp wait like warping to the harbor, no cooldown. The button shows on the Safe House and on unstable islands that have a camp · islands without a camp have no such button You land next to the camp's warp hole (on the side facing the Communication Center) · a camp with no warp hole lands you next to its campfire It cannot be used while dead, in combat mode, or while sailing out of the island If you die on an unstable island that has a camp and choose "Revive at Camp", you respawn at that same spot — Death & Revival

Use a map voucher to reveal the whole island map without walking it · vouchers are kept separately in your wallet (Market and Shop) · on Unstable Islands an opened map lasts until the island expires — the new island needs a new one

Farming encyclopedia — each seed has its own level (max 20), +20 EXP per harvest · pick a specialization every 5 levels — details on Farming Discovering a new animal species for the first time gives Survival EXP (Skills and Careers)

Each successful natural-item gather has a 35% chance to give you one memo from a set you have not finished on that island (the story reads in order) — a corner notice appears and you can read it in the Encyclopedia · only gathering natural items counts (not butchering, farm harvests, or water spots/traps) · Tamed Islands do not drop memos Faction memos unlock one by one when your friendship points with the faction reach that memo's requirement — you start with 16 already unlocked (Organizations) In total: 505 gathering memos + 342 faction memos [!tip] Every island except Tamed Islands pays 400 per point + 4,000 when complete — fully exploring your first islands is a great T-Stone source for new players
